preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.
The number of edges provided matches the given m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(A) > 0 and len(B) > 0 and len(A) + len(B) <= n and set(A).isdisjoint(set(B)) and all(any(u in A or v in A for u, v in edges) and any(u in B or v in B for u, v in edges) for u, v in edges))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating impossibility, or two disjoint vertex covers A and B such that both are valid vertex covers of the graph.
